'''''Sacrifice at Endor''''' was a [[Holodrama/Legends|holodrama]] that was produced for mass consumption by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and was one of the two most popular segments of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] life story. The work portrayed a twisted and propagandistic version of the events of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], depicting Palpatine as a benevolent savior who had boarded a [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star]] that had been constructed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], in order to destroy it as an outnumbered and outgunned [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] attempted to hold off a vastly superior [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance flotilla]].<ref name="Wedge's Gamble" />

[[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]] bought a [[display disk]] containing the holodrama for his [[Airen Cracken/Legends|father]] as a souvenir during the Rogue's scouting mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the weeks prior to that world's [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|liberation]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. During an undercover mission, Rogue [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] also briefly saw the film at an exhibit in the [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Galactic Museum]] and although he knew the story was if anything the exact opposite of what had really transpired, he nonetheless felt it was just as compelling as the real history.<ref name="Wedge's Gamble" />
